name: renewal-world-cards
author: BlaXun
description: The cards of the monsters of renewal's new lands, made pre-renewal cards: never stronger than pre-renewal's best card of the slot for the same bonus, single-skill bonuses at a third, every card checked for abuse, and renewal's card sets at a third. Each drops from its monster at renewal's rate. A boss's card drops only while renewal-world-mvps is on. Needs renewal-world-monsters.
